proved_scope.rows: Actual smoothMultipleMasked with every mu(h*m), character phase and fixed coprimality mask retained.
proved_scope.portfolio: Arbitrary finite complex character portfolio at one fixed positive modulus. The portfolio is combined before compensation and squaring, so all mixed-character terms remain.
proved_scope.general_power: One K controls all natural d,N and all real D>0 with exponents(15-d)/8+(d+1)u and(8-d)/4+2du.
proved_scope.subpower: For every eps>0, quartic remainder O(D^(11/8+eps)) and octic remainder O(D^(7/8+eps)), uniformly in N>=0,D>=1.
proved_scope.edge_cases: q=1, N=0, arbitrary nonunits and every positive divisor row included. No primitivity or character-order restriction.

parameter_domain: Fixed q,r>0, finite S, Dirichlet characters chi_i modulo q, arbitrary complex weights, C-infinity W supported in[lo,hi] with lo>0 and hi>=0. K depends on these data and positive u with7/8+u<=2, independently of d,N,D.

explicit_costs.portfolio: K=sum_i norm(weight_i)*K_i, where each K_i is supplied by the actual character smooth-row theorem.
explicit_costs.main_term: AA stays signed. No unsigned or Gram estimate is installed for the main packet.
explicit_costs.scope: No noncompact radial carrier, product-amplifier, growing-conductor, prime-sampled quotient or full physical/Abel transfer is inferred.
